news.title: Ex-NFL star Antonio Brown set to appear in Miami court for expected plea agreement
news.summary: Former NFL star wide receiver Antonio Brown is scheduled to be in a Miami courtroom Wednesday to accept a plea deal that will let him avoid prison time on a reduced charge in an attempted murder case
